title: seqeralabs/nf-dragen pipeline parameters
description: nf-dragen is a simple, proof-of-concept Nextflow pipeline to run the Illumina DRAGEN licensed suite of tools.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

seq_type.description: Default type of sequencing (dna, rna etc). Can be overridden in the samplesheet using the column `seq_type`.

dragen_germline_args.description: DRAGEN options for germline runs. Replaces the default.
dragen_germline_args.help_text: The default is `--enable-duplicate-marking true`. Setting this parameter replaces the default, so repeat any default options you want to keep.

dragen_somatic_args.description: DRAGEN options for somatic (tumour/normal) runs. Replaces the default.
dragen_somatic_args.help_text: The default is `--enable-duplicate-marking true --vc-target-vaf 0.03 --enable-sv true`. Setting this parameter replaces the default, so repeat any default options you want to keep. HRD, TMB, HLA and MSI are off by default. Switch them on with, for example, `--dragen_somatic_args '--enable-duplicate-marking true --vc-target-vaf 0.03 --enable-sv true --enable-hrd true --enable-tmb true --enable-hla true --msi-command tumor-normal --msi-coverage-threshold 40'`.

dragen_license.help_text: `marketplace` (default) uses the AWS Marketplace AMI and passes no licence server. For your own licence use `byol` (or `-profile byol`), which declares the Nextflow secrets `DRAGEN_USERNAME` and `DRAGEN_PASSWORD`.

dragen_rna_args.description: DRAGEN options for RNA runs. Replaces the default.
dragen_rna_args.help_text: The default is `--enable-duplicate-marking true`. Setting this parameter replaces the default, so repeat any default options you want to keep.

dragen_hashtable_dna_args.description: DRAGEN options for the DNA hash table build. Replaces the default.
dragen_hashtable_dna_args.help_text: Used only when no `--dragen_index_dna` is given. The default is `--ht-build-cnv-hashtable true`. Setting this parameter replaces the default, so repeat any default options you want to keep.

dragen_hashtable_rna_args.description: DRAGEN options for the RNA hash table build. Replaces the default.
dragen_hashtable_rna_args.help_text: Used only when no `--dragen_index_rna` is given. The default is `--ht-build-rna-hashtable true`. Setting this parameter replaces the default, so repeat any default options you want to keep.

skip_dragen.description: Skip all DRAGEN steps, including building the hash tables. Only MultiQC runs.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA file. The DRAGEN hash tables are built from it when no index is given with --dragen_index_dna or --dragen_index_rna.

dragen_index_dna.description: Path to DNA index created by Dragen.
dragen_index_dna.help_text: Use a DNA index created using Dragen with argument '--build-hash-table true'. If not set, an index is built from `--fasta`.

dragen_index_rna.description: Path to RNA index created by Dragen.
dragen_index_rna.help_text: Use an RNA index created using Dragen with arguments '--build-hash-table true' and '--ht-build-rna-hashtable true'. If not set, an index is built from `--fasta`.

target_bed.description: BED file of exome or panel target regions.
target_bed.help_text: Passed to DRAGEN for germline and somatic DNA runs (`--vc-target-bed`; somatic runs also `--sv-call-regions-bed`), never to RNA runs. Leave unset for whole-genome data. Somatic exome runs skip CNV calling.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC
